verdict.rationale: OpenHands' own CLI documentation lists "Auto-approve all actions (use with caution)" as a feature. That directly matches configuring the agent to skip per-action confirmation. The evidence is a single feature-list line, though, with no detail on how it is set or what the default confirmation flow looks like. Missing for 10: documentation of the actual configuration mechanism (flag, setting or command), description of the default per-action confirmation behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure an agent to auto-approve all its actions instead of confirming each one

citations.quote: The Command Line Interface (CLI) is the default mode when you run `openhands`.
